convert-pdf-to-doc-default.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and save it as a DOC document using default conversion options.

convert-pdf-to-doc-image-extraction.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set a recognition mode via DocSaveOptions, and save the document as a DOC file while handling missing files and errors.

convert-pdf-to-docx-auto-detection.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Automatic Content Detection
convert-pdf-to-docx-auto-detection.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF file and save it as a DOCX document using Aspose.Pdf with DocSaveOptions set to automatic content detection.

convert-pdf-to-doc-plain-text.title: Convert PDF to Plain Text DOC using TextAbsorber
convert-pdf-to-doc-plain-text.description: Loads a PDF file, extracts its plain text with Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber, and writes the text to a .doc file, demonstrating a simple PDF‑to‑DOC conversion in text mode.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-metadata.description: Shows how to convert a PDF to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf while setting custom metadata properties such as Author and Title.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-footnotes.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Footnotes Preservation
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-footnotes.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file and saving it as a DOCX document while preserving footnotes using Aspose.Pdf's built‑in enhanced recognition.

convert-pdf-to-docx-extract-images.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Extract Images
convert-pdf-to-docx-extract-images.description: Demonstrates how to convert a PDF file to DOCX format using Aspose.Pdf and then extract all embedded images from the PDF into a specified folder.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-stats.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Generate Conversion Report
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-stats.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, converting it to DOCX format, measuring conversion time, and writing a JSON report with statistics such as page count, conversion duration, and output file size.

convert-pdf-to-docx-and-zip.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Zip the Result
convert-pdf-to-docx-and-zip.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf and then compressing the generated DOCX into a ZIP archive for storage.

convert-pdf-to-docx-and-pdfa.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and then to PDF/A
convert-pdf-to-docx-and-pdfa.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to convert a PDF file to DOCX format and then create a PDF/A‑1b compliant document from the DOCX output, including conversion logging.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-hyphenation.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-hyphenation.description: Shows how to load a PDF file and save it as a DOCX document using Aspose.Pdf's Document and DocSaveOptions classes.

convert-pdf-to-docx-add-table-of-figures.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Extract Images
convert-pdf-to-docx-add-table-of-figures.description: Shows how to extract images from a PDF and then convert the PDF to a DOCX file using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-embedded-fonts.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Embedded Custom Fonts
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-embedded-fonts.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf while registering and embedding custom TrueType/OpenType fonts to ensure consistent rendering.

convert-pdf-to-pptx.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-pptx.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF document and saving it as an editable PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf's default conversion options.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-slides-as-images.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with Slides as Images
convert-pdf-to-pptx-slides-as-images.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to a PPTX file where each slide is rendered as a raster image using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-pptx-slides-as-ima.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PPTX with SlidesAsImages
batch-convert-pdfs-to-pptx-slides-as-ima.description: Shows how to convert all PDF files in a directory to PPTX presentations using Aspose.Pdf, rasterizing each slide as an image by enabling the SlidesAsImages option.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-slidesasimages-high-.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with SlidesAsImages and High DPI

convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-compress.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Compress the Resulting File
convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-compress.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to PPTX using Aspose.Pdf and then recompress the PPTX (a ZIP archive) with optimal compression to reduce its size for distribution.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-pdfa.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Create PDF/A for Archival
convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-pdfa.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to a PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf, then generating a PDF/A‑1b archival version from the same source PDF.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-annotation-note.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Extract Annotation Notes
convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-annotation-note.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts text from any text annotations on each page, and then converts the PDF directly to a PPTX file using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-add-custom-propertie.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with Custom Document Properties
convert-pdf-to-pptx-add-custom-propertie.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding built‑in and custom document properties, and saving it as a PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-extract-images.title: Convert PDF to PPTX using Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-pptx-extract-images.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a PPTX presentation by loading the PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Document and saving it with the SaveFormat.Pptx option.

pdf-to-pptx-export-slide-titles-csv.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Export Slide Titles to CSV
pdf-to-pptx-export-slide-titles-csv.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to PPTX format using Aspose.Pdf and extracting the first line of each page as a slide title, which is then written to a CSV file.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-logo.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with Logo on Each Slide
convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-logo.description: Shows how to load a PDF, add an image stamp (company logo) to every page, and then save the modified document as a PPTX using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-single-page-html.title: Convert PDF to Single-Page HTML with Embedded Resources
convert-pdf-to-single-page-html.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, configure HtmlSaveOptions to embed fonts, CSS, and images, and save the document as a single-page HTML file while handling Windows‑specific GDI+ requirements.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-svg-images.title: Convert PDF to HTML and Export SVG Images

convert-pdf-to-html-with-svg-compression.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Embedded Resources
convert-pdf-to-html-with-svg-compression.description: Shows how to load a PDF document and save it as a single HTML file with all resources embedded, using HtmlSaveOptions to control image handling and embedding.

convert-pdf-to-html-png-background.title: Convert PDF to HTML with PNG Background Rendering
convert-pdf-to-html-png-background.description: Loads a PDF file and converts it to a single HTML document, embedding all resources and rendering background images as PNGs embedded in SVG.

convert-pdf-pages-to-separate-html-files.title: Convert PDF Pages to Separate HTML Files
convert-pdf-pages-to-separate-html-files.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configure HtmlSaveOptions to split each page into its own HTML file, and save the output while handling platform‑specific limitations.

pdf-to-html-with-toc.title: Convert PDF to HTML Pages and Generate Table of Contents

pdf-to-html-per-page-image-folders.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Per-Page Image Subfolders
pdf-to-html-per-page-image-folders.description: Shows how to convert a PDF to HTML using Aspose.Pdf, split the output into separate pages, and reorganize the generated raster images into page‑specific subfolders.

convert-pdf-to-html-compressed-svg.title: Convert PDF to HTML with SVG Image Options
convert-pdf-to-html-compressed-svg.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF document and saving it as an HTML file while configuring SVG image handling options using Aspose.Pdf.

pdf-to-html-merge-and-convert-back.title: Split PDF into HTML pages, combine them, and convert back to PDF
pdf-to-html-merge-and-convert-back.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf to convert a PDF into separate HTML files per page, merge those HTML pages into a single document, and then convert the combined HTML back into a PDF.

convert-pdf-to-html-zip.title: Convert PDF to HTML and Create a ZIP Archive
convert-pdf-to-html-zip.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, converting each page to HTML, and packaging the generated files and assets into a ZIP archive for distribution.

convert-pdf-to-html-and-minify.title: Convert PDF to HTML and Minify the Output
convert-pdf-to-html-and-minify.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to convert a PDF document into separate HTML pages and then minify the generated HTML files to reduce size and improve loading speed.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-custom.title: Convert PDF to HTML and Embed Custom Fonts
convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-custom.description: Shows how to convert a PDF into a single HTML file with embedded resources using Aspose.Pdf, then adds @font-face rules to the generated CSS to embed custom TrueType fonts.

pdf-to-responsive-html.title: Convert PDF to Responsive HTML
pdf-to-responsive-html.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a single HTML file with Aspose.Pdf and inject a responsive CSS stylesheet for mobile‑friendly rendering.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-custom-css.description: Shows how to convert a PDF to a single HTML file using Aspose.Pdf and then inject a <link> tag to reference an external CSS stylesheet.

convert-pdf-to-html-sitemap.title: PDF to HTML Conversion with Sitemap Generation
convert-pdf-to-html-sitemap.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF into split HTML files using Aspose.Pdf and creating a sitemap.xml that lists the generated pages for SEO.

convert-pdf-to-html-pages-with-index.title: Convert PDF to Separate HTML Pages and Create Index
convert-pdf-to-html-pages-with-index.description: Demonstrates converting each page of a PDF into individual HTML files using Aspose.Pdf and generating an index.html that links to those pages.

convert-pdf-to-html-docx-with-embedded-f.title: Convert PDF to HTML and Embed Custom Font in DOCX
convert-pdf-to-html-docx-with-embedded-f.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF to HTML with Aspose.Pdf, registering a custom TrueType font, and then saving the HTML as a DOCX with the font embedded for consistent rendering.

convert-pdf-to-bmp-images.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and save each page as a BMP file using BmpDevice.

convert-pdf-to-epub.title: Convert PDF to EPUB
convert-pdf-to-epub.description: Shows how to load a PDF document and save it as an EPUB file using Aspose.Pdf with the default conversion settings.

convert-pdf-to-markdown-default-options.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and saving it as a Markdown document using the default MarkdownSaveOptions.

convert-pdf-to-mobixml-with-metadata.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to MobiXml format using Aspose.Pdf while setting the standard author metadata and a custom publisher entry.
